verdict: Mostly reproducible. The identity check (517 + 66 cells), the CV counterfactual (18/222, 89 of 140, 0.2257/0.2319/0.2256/0.2111), the background-removal counts (85/54/268), the 8-of-37 exact Fourier models at 16384, the 133/9/6 dictionary-readout split, the spurious-product and duplicate-block counts, the 141-of-255 comparison with Part 10, and the 15 equal n_struct all reproduce from the stored files. I also re-derived them through my own code: refits outside dfg_hooks, my own Walsh transforms and an independent oracle fit. atlas_truth's representations match boolfuncs.py and part9/heldout6/suite.py for every target I checked. The stored specs and categories equal the current code's output in all 407 cells. 22 of the 61 claims checked need correcting; grouped, the main ones are: (1) majxor's spectral pair is present at n = 512, which the tooling itself marks complete, contradicting 'never appear'. (2) The second-largest first-fit gap is thrint@256 (0.071). Removing the background does not close it (still 0.071), so 'the two largest gaps are the background's doing' is wrong. (3) thrint reaches error 0 at n = 512, not 1024, and not with weighted blocks. (4) majxor holds all 25 cross-pair characters from 2048, not 4096. parmaj keeps only one folded block from 1024. (5) cnf3's inner term reads the first clause's literals, not the third clause's. (6) Below the structure, 87 cells hold a true character, not 78. (7) The removal gap is 0.035, not 0.036. (8) In section 3, 45 of the 114 differing cells are against v3 out-of-fold fits (not 4), so 'mostly through the variant' overstates. majmaj5's n_struct is not 'after v3's run had stopped'. v3's member was not constant-only for the mod-3 targets at small n. (9) The header's 'cover every target family' contradicts section 4. (10) 'Every representation is verified' is overstated: the check is vacuous for the multiplexer address blocks, absent for the spectral pair, and never checks accept sets. (11) Two heuristics are contradicted by the data: staircases as 'characters only', and multiplexer 'modulated block per data bit' (mux11 only). (12) Character-group shares are unnormalised although section 0 defines group shares as normalised. (13) The short answer's 's ± 3 AND' for symand is in fact -3 and +2. (14) The time stamp for the last merged file is 23:30, not about 23:33. The report also omits a few things. The partner character does not come first for f7_09. The non-monotone lists leave out stair5@256, dlist8, f7_07/f7_09 and several error reversals. The oracle excludes the background: in 27 'dictionary' cells DFG's own error is more than 0.05 below the oracle's. n*_3 for rf06 uses 2 seeds. Part 10's corrections (heuristic mechanism labels, the modulated statistic, the band/interval double count) are not reintroduced.

claims.claim: §0: 'Every representation is verified on all 2^k assignments of the k relevant inputs'.

The spectral-pair representation has no check (verified = None).
